title: [AAPS 3.0.0.1] Omnipod Dash Priming Bugs
symptom: After priming and setting the cannula on the Omnipod Dash, a connection error always appears, requiring the user to click retry to continue. Additionally, the display turns off during priming and attaching despite the 'Display always on' setting being enabled.
evidence_quote: But after priming and setting the canulla, it always shows a connection error. So i just have to click retry and it works fine.
